verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a remote-desktop SaaS that has a management REST API, so this story applies. The evidence documents only a pull-style REST API (listing clients, retrieving session history, closing sessions) and a CLI. Nothing shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for subscribing to events, and polling the API for session history is a developer building block rather than webhook support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
